picker.cannotLook: Your role cannot look animals up by tag yet, so an animal cannot be chosen here. Ask a manager to record it.
picker.hint: Type the ear tag, for example G-0142
picker.noMatch: No live animal has this tag
picker.error: Animals could not be searched. Try again.

animals.title: Animals
animals.description: Every tagged animal: where it is, what it weighs, what it has cost and whether it can be sold.
animals.emptyBody: Animals arrive through a goods receipt, opening stock or a birth. Receive animals to start the register.
animals.noMatchBody: Check the tag, or clear the search and filters.
animals.denied: You do not have access to the animal register

animal.notFound: This animal is not in the register
animal.error: The animal could not be loaded
animal.denied: You do not have access to this animal
animal.withdrawalTitle: Under a withdrawal period: cannot be sold

history.title: History
history.error: The history could not be loaded
history.denied: You do not have access to this history
history.tooLong: This history is too long to show on one page

weigh.title: Weigh {{animal}}
weigh.body: The weight is recorded now, at this moment.

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: Every weighing, by pen and date. Weigh a whole pen at once from a phone.
weights.emptyBody: Weigh a pen or an animal to start its growth record.
weights.denied: You do not have access to weights
weights.penBody: Choose the pen, then type each animal's weight. Only the animals given a weight are sent.
weights.penLoading: Loading the animals in this pen
weights.penError: The animals in this pen could not be loaded.
weights.penEmpty: No live animals are in this pen.
weights.noneTyped: Type at least one weight before sending.
weights.doneWithDuplicates: {{count}} recorded; {{duplicates}} had already been received and were not recorded twice.

health.title: Record a treatment
health.body: A vaccination, treatment, check or deworming, of one animal or a whole pen.
health.penHint: Every animal in the pen is treated; the cost is shared by the server.
health.qtyHint: In the medicine's own unit, up to three decimal places
health.qtyInvalid: Type a quantity such as 2 or 0.5
health.withdrawalHint: Leave empty to use the medicine's own withdrawal period. It cannot be shorter.
health.costHint: A cost, added to the animals; never a price
health.confirmBody: This is recorded against the animals now.
health.consequence: Medicine used leaves the store and its cost is added to the animals. During a withdrawal period they cannot be sold.
health.doneHeld_one: Recorded. {{count}} animal cannot be sold until its withdrawal ends.
health.doneHeld_other: Recorded. {{count}} animals cannot be sold until their withdrawal ends.

healthList.title: Health
healthList.description: Vaccinations, treatments, checks and dewormings, with what was used, what it cost and when each withdrawal ends.
healthList.emptyBody: Record a treatment or vaccination to start the health record.
healthList.error: Health events could not be loaded
healthList.denied: You do not have access to health records

healthEvent.notFound: This health event was not found
healthEvent.error: The health event could not be loaded
healthEvent.denied: You do not have access to this health event
healthEvent.subject: For

mortality.reasonsError: Reasons could not be loaded. Try again.
mortality.disposalHint: How the carcass was disposed of, for the record
mortality.denied: You cannot report deaths or culls

mortalityList.title: Deaths and culls
mortalityList.description: Each death or cull, its reason, the cost written off and where it stands.
mortalityList.emptyBody: A death or cull is reported from the animal's page or here.
mortalityList.error: Deaths and culls could not be loaded
mortalityList.denied: You do not have access to deaths and culls

mortalityRecord.error: The record could not be loaded
mortalityRecord.denied: You do not have access to this record
mortalityRecord.title: {{kind}} of {{tag}}
mortalityRecord.head: Head
mortalityRecord.onlyReporter: Only the person who reported it can submit it.
mortalityRecord.confirmBody: The animal leaves stock and its cost is written off to the mortality account.
mortalityRecord.consequence: At or above the approval threshold a second person must approve first, and nothing is written off until then.
mortalityRecord.pendingTitle: Sent for approval. Nothing has been written off yet.
mortalityRecord.pendingBody: {{summary}} The animal stays on hand until a different person approves.
mortalityRecord.awaiting: Waiting for a second person to approve. The animal stays on hand until then.

move.title: Move {{animal}}
move.confirmBody: The animal is moved between locations in the stock ledger.
move.locationsError: Locations could not be loaded. Try again.

edit.title: Correct {{animal}}
edit.body: Correct a misread tag or the animal's details. A corrected tag is kept in the audit log.

breedingList.title: Breeding
breedingList.description: Matings, the births they are due to give and how each went.
breedingList.emptyBody: Record a mating to follow it to the birth.
breedingList.error: Breeding records could not be loaded
breedingList.denied: You do not have access to breeding records

mating.title: Record a mating
mating.body: The dam, the sire if known, the day, and when the birth is expected.

breedingRecord.notFound: This breeding record was not found
breedingRecord.error: The breeding record could not be loaded
breedingRecord.denied: You do not have access to this breeding record
breedingRecord.title: Breeding of {{tag}}
breedingRecord.failBody: Say why. The record closes and no young are added.

birth.title: Record the birth: {{tag}}
birth.body: Each live young becomes an animal in the register, linked to its dam.
birth.litterHint: All born, alive or not. Leave empty if every one is listed below.
birth.litterTooSmall: The litter cannot be smaller than the young listed
birth.confirmBody: {{count}} young born alive of a litter of {{litter}} join the register.
birth.consequence: Each young enters stock at nil cost by a birth movement.

feed.title: Feed and rations
feed.description: What each pen was fed and what it cost, and the rations each species is fed on.
feed.emptyBody: Record what a pen was fed to put its cost on the animals.
feed.denied: You do not have access to feed

feedDetail.title: Feed given
feedDetail.notFound: This feed issue was not found
feedDetail.error: The feed issue could not be loaded
feedDetail.allocations: Cost shared over the animals by head-days
feedDetail.noAllocations: The cost has not been shared over the animals yet.

feedRecord.title: Record feed given
feedRecord.body: What a pen ate, from which store, on which day.
feedRecord.qtyHint: In the feed's own unit, up to three decimal places
feedRecord.qtyInvalid: Type a quantity above zero, such as 2 or 0.5
feedRecord.fromHint: Leave as the branch feed store unless it came from elsewhere
feedRecord.confirmBody: The feed leaves the store now. Its cost is shared over the animals in the pen by the server.
feedRecord.consequence: Feed for growing animals is added to their cost; for breeding animals it is charged as an expense.
feedRecord.done: Feed recorded for {{pen}}. It is valued when it posts.

rations.emptyBody: A ration says how much of a feed each head of a species eats a day.
rations.name: Name
rations.stageHint: For example starter, grower or finisher
rations.fixed: For {{species}}, fed {{feed}}. Species and feed are fixed once a ration is made.

reportDeath.title: Report a death or cull
reportDeath.description: From the pen: which animal, what happened, and a photograph. It goes to a manager in the same step.
reportDeath.photoHint: The animal where it was found, with its tag in view. It cannot be added later, and a loss above the approval limit is refused without one.
reportDeath.confirmBody: The report goes in with its photograph and is sent for approval at once. The server works out what the animal was worth.
reportDeath.confirmConsequence: If the loss is above the approval limit, a manager must approve it before the animal is written off. Below it, the animal is written off now.
reportDeath.notSent: The report was not sent for approval
reportDeath.pendingBody: A manager decides it in the approvals inbox. Until then nothing is written off and the animal stays on the books.
reportDeath.postedBody: The loss was under the approval limit, so it was written off straight away.
reportDeath.stuckTitle: {{kind}} of {{tag}} is reported, but not yet sent for approval
reportDeath.stuckBody: The report and its photograph are saved. Send it again when you have signal: it is the same report, so it will not be counted twice.
reportDeath.unsentTitle: Reported from this phone, not yet sent
reportDeath.unsentBody: These reports are saved but were not sent for approval. Send each one again.
reportDeath.reasonsDenied: Your role cannot read the reasons for a death
reportDeath.reasonsDeniedBody: A report needs a reason from the list. Ask a manager to report this one, and ask the owner to give your role the reasons.
